scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle.
A designated area for pedestrians to cross the road, identified by specific signs, overhead yellow lights, and pavement markings.
A motor scooter or similar vehicle with a limited top speed.
A rail vehicle that runs on tracks in the street.
A vehicle used to remove snow from the road, equipped with flashing blue lights.
A High Occupancy Vehicle lane, a specially designed lane designated for use by certain types of vehicles with a specified number of occupants.
A vehicle towed by a motor vehicle.

rules.title: General safety requirement for passing
rules.when: the PASSER is not sure they can PASS without danger to themselves or others
rules.action: overtake and PASS another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is not sure they can PASS without danger to themselves or others, the PASSER MUST NOT overtake and PASS another vehicle.

vague_terms.term: without danger to themselves or others
vague_terms.explanation: No specific criteria for 'danger' are given

rules.title: Prohibition on passing snow plows
rules.when: the PASSED VEHICLE is a SNOW PLOW
rules.action: PASS the SNOW PLOW
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSED VEHICLE is a SNOW PLOW, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS the SNOW PLOW.

rules.title: Signal and check before passing
rules.when: the PASSER intends to PASS
rules.action: use the left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to PASS, the PASSER MUST use the left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane.

vague_terms.explanation: No specific distance or time gap defined

rules.title: Watch for hidden hazards when passing
rules.when: the PASSER is about to PASS a vehicle
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the PASSED VEHICLE AND watch for vehicles that may be turning left in front of the PASSER AND watch for vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is about to PASS a vehicle, the PASSER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the PASSED VEHICLE AND watch for vehicles that may be turning left in front of the PASSER AND watch for vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway.

rules.title: Return to lane after passing
rules.when: the PASSER has overtaken the PASSED VEHICLE
rules.action: signal that they want to move back into the original lane AND make the lane change when the entire front of the PASSED VEHICLE is visible in the inside mirror
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER has overtaken the PASSED VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST signal that they want to move back into the original lane AND make the lane change when the entire front of the PASSED VEHICLE is visible in the inside mirror.

rules.title: Do not cut off the passed vehicle
rules.when: the PASSER is returning to the original lane
rules.action: cut off the PASSED VEHICLE by suddenly moving in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is returning to the original lane, the PASSER MUST NOT cut off the PASSED VEHICLE by suddenly moving in front of it.

rules.title: Do not race if passed vehicle speeds up
rules.when: the PASSED VEHICLE speeds up
rules.action: race the PASSED VEHICLE
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSED VEHICLE speeds up, the PASSER MUST NOT race the PASSED VEHICLE.
rules.note: The handbook advises going back to the original lane.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: another driver is trying to PASS the PASSED VEHICLE
rules.action: speed up
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is trying to PASS the PASSED VEHICLE, the PASSED VEHICLE driver MUST NOT speed up.
rules.note: The handbook states this is 'unlawful and dangerous'.

rules.title: Passing at night: low beams
rules.when: the PASSER is approaching a vehicle from behind at night
rules.action: switch headlights to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is approaching a vehicle from behind at night, the PASSER MUST switch headlights to low beams.

rules.title: Passing at night: high beams alongside
rules.when: the PASSER is moving alongside the PASSED VEHICLE at night
rules.action: switch on high beams
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is moving alongside the PASSED VEHICLE at night, the PASSER MUST switch on high beams.

rules.title: Passing at night: return to lane
rules.when: the PASSER can see all of the front of the PASSED VEHICLE in the rear view mirror
rules.action: pull back into the right lane AND signal
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER can see all of the front of the PASSED VEHICLE in the rear view mirror, the PASSER MUST pull back into the right lane AND signal.

rules.title: No passing near pedestrian crossovers
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: PASS any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS any vehicle.

rules.title: No passing near bridges, viaducts, or tunnels
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel
rules.action: PASS left of the centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS left of the centreline.

rules.title: No passing on curves or hills with obstructed view
rules.when: approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to PASS in safety
rules.action: attempt to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to PASS in safety, the PASSER MUST NOT attempt to PASS.

rules.title: No passing on left shoulder
rules.when: the PASSER is on the left shoulder
rules.action: PASS on the left shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is on the left shoulder, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS on the left shoulder.

rules.title: Passing on right shoulder conditions
rules.when: the PASSED VEHICLE is turning left AND the right shoulder is paved
rules.action: drive on the right shoulder to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSED VEHICLE is turning left AND the right shoulder is paved, the PASSER MAY drive on the right shoulder to PASS.

rules.title: No passing in HOV lane buffer zone
rules.when: the HOV LANE is separated from general traffic lanes by a striped buffer zone
rules.action: cross the striped buffer pavement markings
rules.statement: WHEN the HOV LANE is separated from general traffic lanes by a striped buffer zone, the DRIVER MUST NOT cross the striped buffer pavement markings.
rules.note: The handbook states this is 'illegal and unsafe'.

rules.title: Solid line: no passing
rules.when: there is a solid line at the left of the PASSER's lane
rules.action: PASS
rules.statement: WHEN there is a solid line at the left of the PASSER's lane, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS.
rules.note: The handbook states it is 'unsafe to pass'.

rules.title: Broken line: passing allowed
rules.when: there is a broken line at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear
rules.action: PASS
rules.statement: WHEN there is a broken line at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear, the PASSER MAY PASS.

vague_terms.explanation: No specific gap or sight distance given

rules.note: The handbook adds 'if there are enough broken lines ahead to complete the pass safely'.

rules.title: Passing on the right: general permission
rules.when: on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road
rules.action: PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road, the PASSER MAY PASS on the right.

rules.title: Passing on the right: streetcars and left-turning vehicles
rules.when: overtaking a STREETCAR OR a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a STREETCAR OR a left-turning vehicle, the PASSER MAY PASS on the right.

rules.title: Caution when passing on the right
rules.when: driving in the left-most lane with a slower vehicle in front
rules.action: suddenly change lanes and PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the left-most lane with a slower vehicle in front, the PASSER SHOULD NOT suddenly change lanes and PASS on the right.
rules.note: The handbook advises waiting for the vehicle to move to the right.

rules.title: Passing cyclists: minimum distance
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: maintain a minimum distance of one metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST maintain a minimum distance of one metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: Does not specify when 1 metre is impractical

rules.title: Passing cyclists: change lanes
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: change lanes to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle SHOULD change lanes to PASS.

rules.title: Passing cyclists: do not follow too closely
rules.when: following a CYCLIST
rules.action: follow too closely behind the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN following a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST NOT follow too closely behind the CYCLIST.

vague_terms.explanation: No specific distance given, but context implies risk of collision if cyclist stops suddenly

rules.title: Passing cyclists: do not use horn unnecessarily
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: sound the horn unnecessarily
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST NOT sound the horn unnecessarily.
rules.note: If the horn must be used, it should be tapped quickly and lightly from a distance.

rules.title: Passing motorcycles and similar: change lanes
rules.when: passing a MOTORCYCLE, CYCLIST, LIMITED-SPEED MOTORCYCLE, or MOPED
rules.action: PASS by changing lanes
rules.statement: WHEN passing a MOTORCYCLE, CYCLIST, LIMITED-SPEED MOTORCYCLE, or MOPED, the PASSER MUST PASS by changing lanes.
rules.note: The handbook states 'Do not take this as an invitation to pass in the same lane.'

rules.title: Passing streetcars: side
rules.when: passing a STREETCAR
rules.action: PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN passing a STREETCAR, the PASSER MUST PASS on the right, UNLESS driving on a one-way road.

rules.title: Passing streetcars: distance at stops
rules.when: at a streetcar stop where passengers are getting off or on
rules.action: stay at least two metres behind the rear doors
rules.unless: an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers
rules.statement: WHEN at a streetcar stop where passengers are getting off or on, the DRIVER MUST stay at least two metres behind the rear doors, UNLESS an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers.

rules.title: Passing large commercial vehicles: extra room
rules.when: passing a large commercial vehicle
rules.action: allow more room
rules.statement: WHEN passing a large commercial vehicle, the PASSER SHOULD allow more room.
rules.note: The handbook explains this is because large vehicles require longer stopping distances.

rules.title: Passing farm machinery: caution
rules.when: approaching farm machinery
rules.action: PASS until it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN approaching farm machinery, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS until it is safe to do so.
rules.note: The handbook advises to slow down, stay well back, and be cautious.

rules.title: Passing horse-drawn vehicles: caution
rules.when: approaching a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.action: PASS until it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a horse-drawn vehicle, the PASSER MUST NOT PASS until it is safe to do so.
rules.note: The handbook advises to slow down, maintain safe following distance, and give as much distance as possible when passing.

rules.title: Being passed: move right
rules.when: faster traffic wants to PASS
rules.action: move to the right and let it PASS in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to PASS, the PASSED VEHICLE driver MUST move to the right and let it PASS in safety.

rules.title: Being passed on undivided road: watch oncoming traffic
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: pay attention to oncoming traffic AND move closer to the right side of the lane
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane, the PASSED VEHICLE driver MUST pay attention to oncoming traffic AND move closer to the right side of the lane.

rules.title: Being passed on undivided road: be prepared to slow
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: be prepared to slow down to let the passing driver get in front more quickly to prevent a collision
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane, the PASSED VEHICLE driver MUST be prepared to slow down to let the passing driver get in front more quickly to prevent a collision.

rules.title: Being passed by truck in truck passing lane
rules.actor: DRIVER in the lane next to the far left lane
rules.when: a truck wants to PASS in the truck passing lane
rules.action: move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN a truck wants to PASS in the truck passing lane, the DRIVER in the lane next to the far left lane MUST move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible.
rules.note: Applies to high-speed roads with three or more lanes in each direction where trucks are not allowed in the far left lane.

rules.title: Being passed: do not cut in front
rules.when: a faster moving vehicle is behind
rules.action: cut in front of the faster moving vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a faster moving vehicle is behind, the SLOWER VEHICLE driver MUST NOT cut in front of the faster moving vehicle.
rules.note: The handbook states this is 'dangerous and illegal'.

rules.title: Passing while towing: ensure enough time and room
rules.when: about to PASS
rules.action: make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS
rules.statement: WHEN about to PASS, the PASSER towing a TRAILER MUST make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS.

rules.title: Passing while towing: allow more room before returning
rules.when: having passed the PASSED VEHICLE
rules.action: allow more room before moving back to the lane
rules.statement: WHEN having passed the PASSED VEHICLE, the PASSER towing a TRAILER MUST allow more room before moving back to the lane.

rules.title: Passing while towing: do not cut back too soon
rules.when: returning to the original lane after PASSING
rules.action: cut back into the lane too soon
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after PASSING, the PASSER towing a TRAILER MUST NOT cut back into the lane too soon.

vague_terms.explanation: No specific distance or time given

rules.note: The handbook warns this can cause the trailer to sway.
